scope: Read-only installed package and checkout audit. No app/UI/model/native geometry/inference execution, installation, dependency change, bundle modification or asset parsing. Only pure mocked startup-probe JavaScript tests ran.
provenance_limit: The installed v0.4.3 package and selected flow signatures are authenticated; this does not assert that its compiled renderer/main were built from current HEAD. Installed generator_registry.py differs from the reviewed checkout.

normal_GLB_flow.fact: Normal Import calls Electron selectMeshFile then useApi.importMesh; stores returned URL as current and original output, with no generation request.
Single-file native picker accepts glb/obj/stl/ply/splat and returns the selected path.
POST /optimize/import-by-path sends only the selected path; no renderer base64/full-file copy.
GLB registers the original path and returns serve-file URL without trimesh decoding or conversion.
FileResponse serves the original GLB bytes with model/gltf-binary media type.
GLB Export creates an anchor to apiUrl plus current output URL; no renderer mesh serialization or conversion.

viewer_and_material_observations.fact: useGLTF loads the scene; solid mode restores its original material.
Every geometry receives a synchronous BVH, and every material is made DoubleSide in memory.

Installed BVH defaults indirect=false; GeometryBVH primitiveBuffer is the geometry index array and sortUtils partitions/swaps its entries. Viewer face order can change without touching the source file.
Scene is centered on the display grid; stats use position accessor and index counts. This display transform is not serialized by direct GLB export.
Gizmo drag commits only local pose history; transformMesh has no callers outside its hook definition. Direct GLB export therefore does not export that displayed pose.
Accessor component type chooses the typed array and BufferAttribute; an F32 COLOR_0 is not converted to BYTE_COLOR by this loader.
Color attribute enables vertexColors; missing normals enable flat shading.
Base RGB factors are read as LinearSRGB; metallic and roughness scalar factors are retained. GPU shading and viewer lighting do not prove numerical appearance equality to prior Blender renders.

startup_review.isolation: Set precreated plain userData/sessionData/downloads under new private root while paused. Keep profile settings models/workspace/workflows/extensions/agent private and empty; reuse existing dependency venv read-only. Matching setup version3/requirements hash avoids installer. Inherit PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1.
startup_review.updater_controls: Cache the same installed electron-updater singleton; deny checkForUpdates/downloadUpdate/quitAndInstall/install and keep autoInstallOnAppQuit false via accessor. BaseUpdater autoquit calls install directly. Record controls before resume.
startup_review.no_model_execution_basis: Empty private extensions prevent legacy generator.py import/constructor side effects. Registry.initialize only discovers/instantiates adapters and does not call load. Do not run generation, model download/load, chat or extension setup.
startup_review.port: Verify8765 unused; PythonBridge otherwise kills processes using that port before starting its backend.
startup_review.identity: Preserve installed executable/ASAR and original app/render/import/export code. Report installed provenance and in-memory isolation rather than claiming exact HEAD build.

runtime_unknowns: Observe real download activation, save path/filename and SHA256. Cross-origin anchor download has no serve-file Content-Disposition and no app will-download handler; this is a runtime check, not an observed failure.
Synchronous multi-million-triangle BVH may cause delay/memory pressure; no actual full import has been run by this audit.
NonGLB import/export and smooth/decimate/transform reserialization are outside the original-binary preservation guarantee.
test_scope: Existing tests cover workspace paths, operation routing, conversion/slicer helpers, not native picker to large GLB download. They were inspected, not executed by this audit.
